requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yun Zhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I brought three bags, all from the best in the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep all night."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Before he finished speaking, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the foot of the mountain."}, {"id": 1, "text": "He panted and said, a young woman was lying on the roadside at the foot of the mountain"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Quick, lift her up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wanqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The injury is not serious, it's just that her spiritual power is depleted. Feed her a Spirit Recovery Pill."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the barrier. I and Senior Brother Wanqi are here."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Okay. Miss Qiu has woken up, come call me immediately."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Jie Xuan stood at the palace entrance, his sword unsheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin, it has been a while. I come under the阁主's orders to collect thirty percent of the spirit stones."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three parts? The spirit stones are what the sect has worked hard to save; when is it outsiders' turn to take them?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The barrier is cracked, and it's not safe to keep the spirit stones in your hands. I will come again in three days."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Jie Xuan sneered, turned and left, without looking back."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I said three days, and I always keep my word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at Chou Shuang, who was sleeping on the couch."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Miss Qiu has Lechuan to take care of her, so I can leave."}, {"id":1, "text": "Finally, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the formation eye token. Only by guarding it can you be said to have guarded your path."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Lechuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yunzhou's embrace and whispered a few more instructions."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "At the mountain entrance, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat."}, {"id":1, "text": "Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Qiu woke up, and she said thank you for me."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the array core token close to him."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious all day, don't move around."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the cracked sky outside the window."}, {"id":1, "text": "Unnoticed, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."}]}

translations.1: In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the barrier. I and Senior Brother Wanqi are here.
translations.11: Okay. Miss Qiu has woken up, come call me immediately.
translations.12: Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Jie Xuan stood at the palace entrance, his sword unsheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, it has been a while. I come under the阁主's orders to collect thirty percent of the spirit stones.
translations.15: Three parts? The spirit stones are what the sect has worked hard to save; when is it outsiders' turn to take them?
translations.16: The barrier is cracked, and it's not safe to keep the spirit stones in your hands. I will come again in three days.
translations.17: Jie Xuan sneered, turned and left, without looking back.
translations.18: I said three days, and I always keep my word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at Chou Shuang, who was sleeping on the couch.
translations.2: Yun Zhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Miss Qiu has Lechuan to take care of her, so I can leave.
translations.21: Finally, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the formation eye token. Only by guarding it can you be said to have guarded your path.
translations.23: Lechuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yunzhou's embrace and whispered a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain entrance, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Qiu woke up, and she said thank you for me.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the array core token close to him.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious all day, don't move around.
translations.29: Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the cracked sky outside the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all from the best in the back mountain.
translations.30: Unnoticed, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep all night.
translations.5: Before he finished speaking, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the foot of the mountain.

translations.7: Quick, lift her up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills.
translations.8: Wanqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: The injury is not serious, it's just that her spiritual power is depleted. Feed her a Spirit Recovery Pill.
